speaker: Doctor
text: Welcome to my clinic. I need to examine the skin lesion you are concerned about to determine its nature. Can you tell me how long you have had this spot and if it has changed in size, shape, or color recently?

speaker: Patient
text: 62-year-old male. The patient has recently immigrated to the US from Africa and seeks evaluation for a non-healing, red, crusty lesion on the shaft of his penis and a similar lesion on his left middle finger. Previous treatments in his home country for syphilis and eczema have been unsuccessful. The patient is a smoker, with a history of two packs per day for the last 30 years.

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Penile and digital squamous cell carcinoma. The patient's history of heavy smoking, non-healing crusty lesions on the penis and finger, and failed treatments for syphilis and eczema are highly suggestive of malignancy. I will proceed to biopsy both lesions to confirm the diagnosis and determine the stage.
